audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Theorem B (1.20) fails for its full Sobolev-exponent range; Lemma 2.6 large-contrast algebraic bounds are false; The additive Poisson model can be negative
limitations: Theorem B (1.20) fails for its full Sobolev-exponent range — Counterevidence: The example satisfies Omega, all stochastic hypotheses, U subset E1, smooth g and the exact weighted closure; Theorem A's uniform ellipticity is absent, so Theorem A is not refuted.

Lemma 2.6 large-contrast algebraic bounds are false — Counterevidence: No coefficient-field realization is needed for this algebraic lemma. Intrinsic Theta=(t+1)^2/4 differs from tildeTheta=t, so (2.98) and all later field-dependent results are not thereby refuted.
The additive Poisson model can be negative — Counterevidence: Arbitrarily low positive intensity does not remove the event. No saturation convention is defined; AppendixD1 only changes radius.

Nonsymmetric matrix exponentiation does not give the claimed ellipticity — Counterevidence: The positive rotation family belongs to Omega, so an implicit positivity restriction does not rescue the uniform D3 estimate.
Independent-sum tail (C.15) loses sample-size dependence — Counterevidence: This does not refute the weaker normalized(C.16) or the separate(C.31) argument; their exact constants were not re-proved.

Renormalization scale selection does not supply its stated premises — Counterevidence: The finite matrix sequence is not claimed realized by a random field. The constant-field witness satisfies Proposition3.3's conclusion. Fixed tolerance/exponents can retain log-squared contrast order conditional on the other steps.

The printed fractional-field finite-range construction is invalid — Counterevidence: Cross-scale independence is not required byD2/D4. A valid qualitative replacement exists. Proposition1.2 itself is not refuted.
M25-0108-P01 — Counterevidence: TheoremA uniform ellipticity excludes this field. This refutes the specified TheoremB exponent quantifier, not all other conclusions.

M25-0108-P04 — Counterevidence: The positive rotation family specifically defeats implicit positivity as a rescue. Norms ofa anda^-1 are1 and do notcontrolsym(a)^-1. The deterministic example is not mislabelled as a Gaussian realization.
M25-0108-P05 — Counterevidence: Does not refute normalizedC16, separateC31, orTheoremA. A full repaired bound withoriginalconstants wasnot proved.
Limitations: Complete152-page text reading is not a line-by-line independent reproof of every assertion.
Limitations: General nonselfadjoint existence and all external [AK24],[JK95],[DLV18],[FP97] proofs not independently reconstructed.
Limitations: All repaired high-contrast/low-contrast parameters and exact probability constants not propagated.
Limitations: Lemma4.4 full generality, Theta0-versus-Theta reduction, large-sigma range, quenched low-index convention andD=0 endpoint remain unresolved, not confirmed false-theorem claims.
Limitations: Journal final PDF and equivalence not obtained; limited errata search found no correction but is not an exhaustive absence proof.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
